wooer|UW T ER.why: 'Wooer' is UW1 ER0 with no T, so it lacks the UW-T-ER key of 'computer'.

beauts|UW T S.why: Rime UW1 T S matches 'grassroots' (UW2 T S); the onset is ignored.

brutes|UW T S.why: Rime UW1 T S matches the 'roots' ending of 'grassroots'.

foots|UW T S.why: 'Foots' has the vowel UH (UH1 T S), not UW, so it differs from 'roots'.

soups|UW T S.why: 'Soups' ends in UW1 P S, not UW T S; the P differs from T.
